label: the device class is written first instead of last (Analytics Engine columns are positional, so every row already stored is silently re-labelled and there is no update to fix them with)
the user-agent itself lands in the row (the privacy ceiling is gone and a row can single a visitor out, which is the claim the whole feature rests on)
an unrecognised user-agent is reported as desktop (the fallback inflates the one number a site owner is most likely to act on, and unknown becomes unreachable)
mobile is tested before tablet (an iPad announces Mobile and an Android tablet is an Android without it, so every tablet is filed as a phone or a desktop)
the server-worker branch writes the assets-only entry (a dynamic site's server rendering is replaced by a raw asset serve, and main names a file that is not there)

the counting server-worker config drops run_worker_first (the asset router serves every prerendered page itself, so the shim is never invoked and counts almost nothing while looking completely deployed)

label: the shim stops forwarding the adapter's other handlers (a scheduled or queue handler silently stops firing, with nothing logged)
the shim counts every response, not just a delivered page (the asset router's fallback carries every 404 scan here, so path-scanning bots become pageviews)
the shim stops being excluded from the served tree (it carries the per-publish hash salt, so the visitor hash stops being irreversible)
only this publish's own counter is considered stale (the OTHER branch's leftover survives a change of build shape and its salt is uploaded as an ordinary asset)
the local server serves the shim (the salt that makes the visitor hash irreversible is handed out over loopback, deploy scaffold and all)
